workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260817-01 verified a targeted app-server fail-closed migration boundary: before permissive ClientRequest deserialization, the removed permissionProfile field is explicitly rejected on thread/start, thread/resume, thread/fork and turn/start with invalid-params guidance to use named permissions; unrelated unknown fields remain forward-compatible, and tests show the connection remains usable after rejection. Q-20260817-02 verified per-environment shell-variable policy ownership: EnvironmentConfig now carries and debug-redacts ShellEnvironmentPolicy; selected turn environments supply that policy to regular shell, user-shell and unified-exec environment construction, with a session-derived inferred fallback; tests use conflicting thread/environment policies to demonstrate selected-environment filtering while preserving environment-owned explicit values. Q-20260817-03 verified bounded TUI command compaction: only successful Agent and UnifiedExecStartup activity is grouped, groups flush on failures/non-groupable or interaction boundaries and at 32 completed calls, while transcript_lines retains individual commands/output and replay applies the same grouping without duplicate starts. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久核验后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260817-01 核验了 App-server 的定向 Fail-closed 迁移边界：在允许未知字段的 ClientRequest 反序列化之前，已移除的 permissionProfile 字段会在 thread/start、thread/resume、thread/fork、turn/start 四个方法上被显式拒绝并返回 Invalid Params，同时提示改用命名 permissions；无关未知字段仍保持前向兼容，测试还证明拒绝后连接仍可继续使用。Q-20260817-02 核验了执行环境级 Shell 变量策略所有权：EnvironmentConfig 现在携带 ShellEnvironmentPolicy，并在 Debug 输出中将其脱敏；普通 Shell、User Shell 与 Unified Exec 都从已选择的 Turn Environment 获取该策略，缺少已解析环境配置时使用 Session 推导的 Fallback；测试通过构造互相冲突的 Thread/Environment Policy，证明选中环境负责继承过滤，同时保留环境自身的显式变量值。Q-20260817-03 核验了有界 TUI 命令压缩：只有成功的 Agent 与 UnifiedExecStartup 活动可被分组；失败、非可分组来源、交互边界以及 32 个已完成调用都会形成刷新边界；与此同时 transcript_lines 保留逐命令与输出细节，Replay 使用相同分组逻辑且避免重复 Command Start。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
